primitives.name: Environment Variable Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Lessons applied.** - **Envs are validated at build time, not read ad hoc.** The template fails the build on a missing `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` rather than discovering it at runtime on a customer's phone.
primitives.assumptions: Critical configuration parameters must be checked early to prevent unpredictable runtime failures.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Static analysis of environmental dependencies during compilation.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's state-transition logic: both enforce immediate error handling upon encountering invalid inputs to prevent system instability.
layer2.telemetry: Build-time exit codes or compile-time exceptions triggered by missing environment variables.

primitives.name: Retry Policy Configuration
primitives.verbatim_quote: This app reads one env var (`EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`) and defaults it to the canonical www host rather than failing — a deliberate divergence, because a missing API base should point at production, not brick the app.
primitives.assumptions: HTTP status codes carry semantic meaning that should drive application-level retry strategies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Custom error-handling logic overriding generic network retry mechanisms.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal inference framework: both involve rejecting default heuristics when the underlying distribution shifts.
layer2.telemetry: Counters for HTTP 5xx errors with custom error codes versus generic exponential backoff attempts.
